cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -1.09% · WTI +1.01% · Brent +3.65% · NatGas -3.62%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Shale & E&P is doing the heavy lifting at +3.56%.

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +3.56%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.30%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at -14.84%
cards.body: Leaders: AR +5.79%, OVV +4.84%, APA +4.38%, TRGP +4.37%, FANG +4.27%. Laggards: EOSE -14.84%, LEU -9.50%, FLNC -9.02%, OKLO -6.63%.
